title: Flatness of a prepared partial chart local ring
statement: Let R be a Noetherian commutative ring, let Cbar be a commutative R-algebra with a compatible R/(pi^2)-algebra structure, and let pi be in R. Let d be prepared Popescu lifting data [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-lift-preparation]. For k in Fin d.r, form the explicit partial chart D_k and its map to the full lifting algebra D as in [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-lift-partial-chart-dimension]. If q is a prime of D containing the image of pi and avoiding the image of a_k, let q_k be its inverse image in D_k. Then (D_k)_{q_k} is a flat R-module. The local ring and flatness are as in [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] and [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].

proof.text: Define the finite-chart prime using finiteChartEquiv. Apply partial_chart_fibre_dimension and exists_flat_away_of_fibre_dimension_eq to obtain flatness of the finite-chart localization. Transport it across the explicit localization algebra equivalence induced by finiteChartEquiv.

lean.statement:
theorem partial_chart_flat_repair {R : Type a} {Cbar : Type c}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing Cbar] [Algebra R Cbar] (π : R)
    [Algebra (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    [IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (d : PopescuLiftPresentation R Cbar π) (hd : d.Prepared)
    (k : Fin d.r) (q : PrimeSpectrum d.liftingAlgebra)
    (hπ : algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π ∈ q.asIdeal)
    (hk : ULift.up (Ideal.Quotient.mk d.definingIdeal
      (d.includeX (d.a k))) ∉ q.asIdeal) :
    Module.Flat R (d.chartLocal k q)
